# uv-updater

The `uv` updater of `infra/deps`: plans and applies moves of every `python/`
project's `uv.lock` and its exact `.python-version` (CPython) pin, under a
3-day release cooldown, with `UV_HOLDS` for releases known to be broken.

It is a sub-plugin rather than part of `deps/python` so the installer kind
(`pythonEnv`, `runPython`) carries no edge to the updater registry, which
files tasks. An app that runs Python but must stay free of the agent runtime
(Sonata, through `infra/audio-analysis`) then closes over the installer only.

- Server:

  - Uses: `infra/deps/updates.UpdaterDeclare`
